oneOf.description: A newer queued item with the same `supersede_key` replaced it.

DeliveryState.description: Delivery state recorded on an item as it moves through the queue.

Set aside untyped: cancelled or expired.

description:
A queue item: the JSON object in one phase file of a queue.

Only `text` is required. The writers in [`crate::queue`] add `id`,
`queued_at` and `delivery_attempts` at enqueue; drainers add the
delivery fields. Sender fields not listed here are allowed and
ignored by readers, so the schema allows additional properties.

cancel_reason.description: Why the item was set aside, when it was.

cancelled_at.description: Unix seconds when the item was set aside.

confirmed_at.description: Unix seconds when delivery was confirmed.

delivery_attempts.description: How many delivery attempts have been made.

delivery_blocked_at.description: Unix seconds when delivery was found blocked.

delivery_error.description: The last delivery error, when one was recorded.

delivery_state.description: The item's delivery state, when a drainer has recorded one.

draft_recovered_at.description: Unix seconds when an unsent draft was recovered.

draft_recovered_evidence.description: How a recovered draft was evidenced.

id.description: The message identifier; equals the file name without `.json`.

inflight_at.description: Unix seconds when the item entered `inflight/`.

inflight_from.description: The lane the item entered `inflight/` from.

not_after.description:
Unix time in milliseconds after which no drainer types the
item; only an `inbox.v2` item may carry one. `null` is none.

opening.description: Opening text recorded by a sender.

paste_label.description: The numbered placeholder the harness drew for the paste, without its blanks.

paste_started_at.description: Unix seconds immediately before the first terminal input.

paste_tracking.description: Whether a tracking drainer stamped the item at the barrier.

possibly_submitted.description: Whether the item may have been typed already.

probable_misroute.description: Whether the item probably reached the wrong terminal.

queued_at.description: Unix seconds, fractional, when the item was queued.

sent_at.description: Original send time recorded by a sender, in its own units.

stranded_at.description:
Unix seconds when the prompt was first left stranded at the bottom of a TUI's screen
after its Enter presses; it stays pending, and later passes only press Enter.

stranded_passes.description: Drain passes that found the prompt still stranded.

supersede_key.description:
Sender-chosen key naming what this item is the latest word on, within
its queue: enqueueing an item sets aside every still-pending item
with the same key (see `superseded_by`). Items without a key are
never superseded and supersede nothing.

superseded_by.description:
The identifier of the newer item that superseded this one, recorded
when it was set aside with reason `superseded`.

tui_delivery_attempts.description: Alias of `delivery_attempts` written by some drainers.

tui_delivery_error.description: Last terminal-delivery error recorded by a drainer.

tui_delivery_failed_at.description: When terminal delivery last failed, as an ISO timestamp.

typed_as.description: The text actually typed, when it is not `text`.

title: QueueItem
